selected.$description: the chosen circle is the inverse solid; the others have no fill at all (ADR-0029 §3.3)

fill.$description: the opposite-colored dot on the solid circle

size.$description: 8 px, the button-icon-gap step of the 4 px rhythm (visual-dna §6.1); a dot, not a glyph
the circle is the glyph box a control carries, 20 px (visual-dna §1 principle 13); the hit region is size.hit around it
